title: Lane Seven
logline: A gentle, slow-talking boy from rural Georgia swims his way through five Olympic Games and forty years of American history.
plot: Born with weak legs and a simple, trusting mind, Walter Bell learns to swim in the creek behind his mother's boarding house because it is the only place he can move freely. A high-school coach spots him, and in 1964 he swims for the United States at the Tokyo Olympics without ever quite understanding what the fuss is about. Over the next four decades Walter keeps turning up at the Games, as an athlete, a lifeguard and finally a coach, stumbling into the Munich massacre, the 1980 boycott and the Atlanta bombing. Through it all he writes letters to Ruthie, the girl from the creek, who drifts through protest movements and bad marriages, and who he is sure will one day come to watch him race.

title: All In
logline: Two Harvard roommates build the world's biggest online poker site, then bet the company against each other in an underground game.
plot: In 2003 a socially awkward Harvard sophomore writes a poker program in his dorm room to beat his classmates, and his roommate, a finance student, puts up the money to turn it into a website. Within a year it has millions of players, a Silicon Valley investor with his own plans, and a lawsuit from the twins who say the idea was theirs. As the founder quietly dilutes his friend's shares to nothing, the betrayed roommate challenges him to a private no-limit game in a Macau casino with their stakes in the company on the table. Told through depositions and the hands of the game itself, it asks whether the founder ever cared about anything except winning.

title: The Sitter
logline: A portrait painter in a sunny seaside town realizes every person who has ever posed for him is an actor, and his paintings are a television show.
plot: Elias is an insurance clerk in a sunny island town who paints portraits on weekends, cheerful and loved by his neighbors, with no idea that his whole life is a reality television show broadcast live around the world since his birth. His wife, his best friend and his sitters are actors, five thousand hidden cameras watch him, and the show's creator directs the weather from a control room in the moon. When a stage light falls from the sky and his dead father appears among the extras, Elias begins to paint what he is not supposed to see: the cameras, the actors between takes, the painted horizon of the dome. His canvases become a message to the audience, and he must overcome his fear of the water and sail out to find the door in the sky.

title: The Calculators of Pretoria
logline: In 1976 South Africa, three Black women working as human computers on the state rocket program are caught up in the Soweto uprising.
plot: In the 1970s, three brilliant Black women mathematicians work as human computers at South Africa's secret space and rocket program, calculating orbits and launch trajectories by hand in a segregated room on the far side of the base. Thandi is the best of them, but she must walk half a mile to the only bathroom she is allowed to use, and the white engineers will not let her attend the briefings. When the program installs a new IBM computer that nobody can program and a satellite launch depends on her equations, the director tears down the whites-only sign and lets her into the control room, while outside the students of Soweto are rising against apartheid.

title: The Patron
logline: A celebrated painter's secret patron, who has guided his work for twenty years, turns out to exist only in his mind.
plot: In 1950s Paris, a socially awkward American painter of genius is recruited by a mysterious government agent to hide coded messages in his abstract canvases to foil a Soviet plot. His wife, a former student, watches him grow paranoid and obsessed, filling his studio with charts and numbers. When she discovers that the agent, his college roommate and the little girl who visits him have never existed, he is diagnosed with paranoid schizophrenia and taken to a psychiatric hospital for insulin shock treatment. Refusing the medication that dulls his talent, he learns over decades to ignore the hallucinations that still follow him, until, an old man, he is honored with a retrospective and thanks his wife for believing in him.

title: Villain Night
logline: A washed-up supervillain and his tiny henchmen enter a deadly televised game show for villains to pay for the orphans he accidentally adopted.
plot: Grimsby was once the world's most feared supervillain, but his last heist was stealing the Moon's reflection, and now he is broke. When three orphaned sisters he took in as part of a scheme start calling him Dad, he needs money fast and signs up for Villain Night, an underground tournament where criminals gamble their lairs, their minions and their lives on rigged games of chance. Each round eliminates a contestant through a trapdoor. Helped by his hundred squeaking helpers and a rival with a laser grudge, Grimsby must cheat the house without letting the girls find out what their new father does for a living.

title: Take Two
logline: The plastic star of a children's toy movie walks off the set and into the chaos of the film production that invented her.
plot: In Dollworld every day is perfect for Stereotypical Dolly and the other dolls, the beach-loving boyfriend Kenny included, until Dolly suddenly has thoughts of death, flat feet and cellulite. To fix herself she and Kenny travel to the real world, where they discover she is the star of a toy company's live-action movie whose troubled production in Los Angeles is shaping her doll's life: reshoots change her personality, executives in the boardroom rewrite her ending and Kenny falls for the patriarchy he finds on the studio lot. With the help of a tired screenwriter and her teenage daughter, Dolly must get into the editing room to decide what kind of doll, and woman, she wants to be.

seed: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade (1989)
title: The Ghent Panel
logline: An archaeology professor and his estranged art-historian father race Nazis across Europe for a stolen panel of a medieval altarpiece.
plot: In 1938 a two-fisted American archaeologist learns that his father, a fussy scholar of Flemish painting, has vanished in Belgium while tracing the lost panel of a famous altarpiece, said to hide a map in its brushwork. Hitler's art looters want it for the Führer's museum. Dodging the Gestapo, father and son bicker their way through Venetian canals, a castle full of seized masterpieces and a zeppelin over the Alps, decoding the painting's symbols by its varnish and pigments. The search ends in a burning monastery where they must choose between the painting, the treasure it points to and each other.

title: Ashfall
logline: Champions of a televised fight to the death are sent back into the arena just as the island volcano beneath it erupts.
plot: In a dystopian nation ruled by a capital that keeps its districts in line with an annual televised death match, last year's victors are forced back into a new arena built on a volcanic island. The games begin on schedule, but the seismologists the capital ignored were right: the volcano erupts on the second day. With ash blotting out the cameras, lava cutting off the arena and a tsunami bearing down on the coast, the tributes who were meant to kill each other must work together to reach the only evacuation boat, while the government decides whether to rescue them or let the disaster finish the show.

title: The Floating Circus
logline: A 19th-century showman's troupe of performers is shipwrecked on a voyage to Europe and must survive on a deserted island, in song.
plot: In 1852 an ambitious American impresario charters a clipper ship to take his circus of outcasts, a bearded lady, a giant, trapeze artists and a tiny general, on a grand tour of the courts of Europe. A storm wrecks the ship on a reef, and the troupe is cast ashore on an uninhabited island with the crew, a mutinous first mate and a hold full of costumes. The showman, who has always sold dreams, must keep his people alive with no audience to applaud them, and they put on the greatest show of their lives to signal a passing whaler. A musical about spectacle, survival and the family that forms on a desert island.

seed: Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones (2002)
title: Clone Moon
logline: A young warrior-monk sent to guard a teenage senator discovers an army of clones being grown in secret on a rainy ocean moon.
plot: In a galaxy where an order of psychic warrior-monks keeps the peace, the apprentice Ren is assigned to protect Aoi, a young senator from a quiet ocean world, after an assassination attempt. Their forbidden romance grows on her home planet while Ren's master follows the assassin to a stormy water moon and finds cloning towers that have been growing an army of identical soldiers for ten years. Among them is one clone, Kei, who has begun to dream of his own name. As the war begins, the hand-drawn anime follows Ren, Aoi and Kei through giant robot battles and a betrayal at the heart of the republic.

title: Summit.exe
logline: In 2045, a gamer chasing a dead billionaire's virtual prize learns the final key is hidden on the real summit of K2.
plot: In 2045, a teenage gamer who escapes his poverty in a virtual reality world learns that its late creator's fortune goes to whoever can reach the summit of K2, the real mountain, and bring back the key hidden there. He and his online friends, who have never met in person, fly to Pakistan and join a team of Sherpa guides and veteran mountaineers at base camp. Fighting avalanches, crevasses, frostbite and the frozen death zone without oxygen, they race a corporation's well-funded climbing expedition that will cut fixed ropes to win. The gamers, who know every route from the virtual replica, must learn real mountaineering on a climb where a fall cannot be reset.

title: Freedom Summer, Again
logline: A Black teenager accidentally sent back to 1964 Mississippi must make sure his civil-rights worker grandparents meet, or he will never exist.
plot: Marcus, a Black teenager who plays guitar, is a friend of an eccentric scientist who has built a time machine from a souped-up Cadillac. When the car's plutonium-powered engine is fired up in a mall parking lot, Marcus is accidentally sent back thirty years to 1964 in a small Mississippi town. He interferes with his parents' first meeting at the high school dance, and his teenage mother falls in love with him instead. With the help of the young version of the scientist, Marcus must get his parents together and survive the town's segregation and the bully who leads its white gang, then catch a bolt of lightning striking the courthouse clock tower to power the car back to the future.

seed: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button (2008)
title: Citizen in Reverse
logline: A man born old in Paris in 1789 grows younger through the French Revolution, the Terror and Napoleon, while the woman he loves grows old.
plot: On the night the Bastille falls a child is born with the body of an old man, abandoned on the steps of a convent and raised by a nun. Lucien grows younger every year. As a white-haired youth he is taken for a nobleman and nearly guillotined; in his middle age he fights in the revolutionary armies; as a young man again he serves Napoleon. All his life he loves Marianne, an actress who ages as he grows young, and they meet only once in the middle, both forty, for a few happy years. Told from her deathbed as she reads his diary, it is a story of time running in two directions through a world turned upside down.

title: Wingmen FC
logline: A cocky Navy fighter pilot is grounded and ordered to captain the base's hopeless soccer team in the armed forces World Cup.
plot: Lieutenant Jake 'Striker' Reyes is the best pilot at the Navy's elite fighter school and knows it, until a reckless stunt over the carrier gets his wingman hurt and him grounded. His commander sentences him to captain the base soccer team, a ragtag squad of mechanics and cooks, in the international military football championship. Reyes treats every match like a dogfight and alienates his team, while falling for the civilian coach the Navy hired to tame him. To beat the elite French paratroopers in the final, he must learn to pass the ball and trust a wingman again.

title: Prime Time
logline: A mentally ill party clown becomes the star of a hidden-camera prank show, and the network keeps filming as he falls apart.
plot: Arthur, a failed stand-up comedian and party clown with a neurological condition that makes him laugh uncontrollably, lives with his ailing mother in a decaying city where the social services that gave him his medication have just been cut. After he kills three wealthy young men who beat him on the subway, a clip of his stand-up act is mocked on the late-night talk show of his idol, and the network books him as a guest because the ratings will be huge. While masked protesters in clown makeup riot in the streets, the producers prepare a live broadcast of the joke, and Arthur arrives at the studio ready to give them the most-watched moment in television history.

seed: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (2003)
title: The Last Fleet of Eldmar
logline: As the dark lord's ironclad navy sails on the last free kingdom, a small sailor must carry a cursed compass to the sea where it was forged.
plot: The shadow realm in the east has built a fleet of black ironclad warships and is sailing on the last free harbor of men and elves. While the exiled king gathers the scattered ships of the alliance for one great sea battle, a halfling cabin boy and his loyal friend carry a cursed compass, the source of the dark lord's power, aboard a stolen fishing boat toward the burning sea where it was forged. Storms, sea serpents and the compass's whispering corrupt them as the fleets meet in a naval war of fire and rams. Only if the compass is destroyed can the free peoples' ships survive.

title: The Last Legion
logline: In 410 AD, Rome's last legion in Britain is trapped on a beach as barbarians close in, waiting for ships that may never come.
plot: The Roman Empire is collapsing and the emperor has ordered his legions home from Britannia. Thousands of soldiers are trapped on a beach on the southern coast with Saxon raiders closing in from the land. The story is told in three overlapping threads: a young legionary trying to get aboard any ship that will take him, over one week; a Gaulish merchant who sails his trading boat across the channel to rescue them, over one day; and a cavalry officer holding the dunes against the raiders, over one hour. With almost no dialogue, the film follows the end of four hundred years of Roman Britain in the struggle simply to survive and get home.

title: The Examiner's Daughter
logline: In imperial China a young woman disguises herself as a man to sit the imperial exams and teach at the emperor's academy, in an animated musical.
plot: When the Emperor orders one man from every family to join the army against the invading Huns, Lin, the spirited daughter of an old war hero, disguises herself as a man and takes her father's place. Instead of the battlefield she is sent to the imperial military academy, where a stern young captain must turn a class of hopeless recruits into soldiers in time for the war. Watched over by her ancestors and a small, boastful dragon spirit, Lin struggles through drills, lessons and the final examination. When her secret is discovered, she is expelled in disgrace, but only she knows the Huns are already inside the city, and she must save her teacher and the Emperor.

title: Cage Home
logline: A Hong Kong family living in a subdivided 'cage home' worms its way into the household of a rich family on the Peak.
plot: The Kims, an unemployed family of four in Hong Kong, live in a subdivided cage home in Sham Shui Po, folding pizza boxes for money and stealing the neighbors' wifi. When the son forges a university diploma to tutor the daughter of the wealthy Park family in their modern mansion on the Peak, the family schemes, one by one, to get the driver and the housekeeper fired and take their jobs. Then, on a night of typhoon rains when the Parks are away, the old housekeeper returns and reveals that her husband has been living secretly in a bunker beneath the house. A birthday garden party, a smell the rich can't stand and a knife bring the two families' worlds together in violence.

title: Comrade Chef
logline: In 1950s Moscow, a rat with a gift for cooking secretly runs the kitchen of a state restaurant feeding Party officials.
plot: Remy, a rat with an extraordinary sense of taste and smell, dreams of becoming a chef like his late idol, whose cookbook says that anyone can cook. Separated from his family, he ends up in the kitchen of the idol's famous restaurant in 1950s Moscow, where he helps Linguini, a clumsy young garbage boy, by hiding under his chef's hat and steering him by pulling his hair. Their soup becomes the talk of the city. But the scheming head chef wants the restaurant for himself, Remy's colony of rats wants to raid the pantry, and a feared food critic from the Party arrives to review the restaurant on the night that will decide whether a rat can be a chef.

title: Blackout in Hollowtown
logline: A city of monsters powered by children's screams faces collapse when an earthquake cracks its scream reactor.
plot: Hollowtown, a city of cheerful monsters, runs on energy collected from the screams of human children through closet doors. When a massive earthquake hits during the morning shift, the cracked scream reactor threatens a meltdown, the doors to the human world jam shut and the city's power grid fails. Two coworkers from the scare floor, a big furry veteran and his one-eyed best friend, are trapped in the collapsing plant with a lost human toddler. As floods and aftershocks tear through the city and the company's boss hides the danger to protect profits, they race to stop the meltdown and get the child home.

title: The Family of the Rue Saint-Denis
logline: In 1789 Paris, the youngest son of a smuggling family is drawn into the family business as the Revolution turns the city upside down.
plot: The aging patriarch of a powerful crime family, Don Vito Corsini, receives petitioners on his daughter's wedding day and refuses to join the other families in the dangerous new trade in smuggled opium. When rivals try to assassinate him, his youngest son Michel, a war hero who wanted no part of the family business, kills a corrupt police captain and a rival boss in a restaurant and hides in Corsica, where his young wife is killed by a bomb meant for him. Returning to Paris in 1789 as the Revolution begins, Michel becomes the new Don, and while he stands as godfather at his nephew's baptism, his men murder the heads of the other families.
